name: Establishing the Controlled Unclassified Information Program
notes: Established the government-wide CUI program to standardize handling of unclassified information requiring safeguarding.

derives_from.note: Vesting Clause (Art. II § 1 cl. 1 — "executive Power shall be vested in a President") and Take Care Clause (Art. II § 3 — President "shall take Care that the Laws be faithfully executed") together authorize the President to direct Executive Branch agencies on the handling of unclassified information.
